{{Quote|Bring him here&mdash;question him, we will.''"<br />"''Yes, Master; I will report back when I have him.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="aotc" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] went to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] on a '''mission''' to find the bounty hunter responsible for the [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|plot]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Kenobi was informed by the [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] of Kamino, [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]], that a bounty hunter named Jango Fett lived in [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of Kamino. After Kenobi questioned Fett about the plot, Fett attempted to escape from Kamino with his [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] son, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. Kenobi confronted Fett and engaged him near [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], Fett's [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. During the duel, Kenobi managed to knock both twin [[WESTAR-34 blaster pistol/Legends|blasters]] out of Fett's hands. Kenobi, however, lost his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and as he used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|pull]] it back to him, Fett used his [[Whipcord launcher/Legends|whipcord launcher]], to yank Kenobi's hands away. The two fought hand-to-hand on the wet surface platform until Kenobi kicked Fett, which caused the bounty hunter to lose his footing and fall off the platform. Kenobi, who was still tied to Fett's whipcord, was pulled off the platform behind him.

Fett disconnected the whipcord that held Kenobi, and the Jedi fell down towards the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] as Fett retreated back to his ship. The Jedi used the Force to secure himself with the cable Fett released, and swung towards a door below the platform they had dueled on. Fett boarded his ship as his son took off, while Kenobi rushed back out onto the platform. Kenobi located his lightsaber and ignited it, but ''Slave I'' had lifted off from the platform. Kenobi took out a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]] from his belt and threw it onto the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the ship. Soon after, Kenobi tracked the pair to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], in his [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 Jedi Starfighter]] and [[Dogfight over Geonosis/Legends|engaged]] Fett once more in the [[asteroid field]] above Geonosis.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Jango, Welcome back. Was your trip productive?''"<br />"''Fairly.''"<br />"''This is Master Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi, He's come to check up on our progress.|Taun We introduces Jango Fett to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="aotc" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] gave [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] a mission to find the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] responsible for the [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|plot]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. While his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], had been given an assignment by the Council to protect Amidala on Naboo, Kenobi went to see his old friend, the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]]&mdash;nicknamed Dex&mdash;in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], to find more information about a [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|toxic dart]] that the Jedi had taken from the body of [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] assassin [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], who had been shot with the dart and [[Death/Legends|killed]] before she could release information about the plot to assassinate Amidala. Dex told Kenobi that the dart belonged to the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] who lived in the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], beyond the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. After he left the diner, Kenobi, with the assistance of [[Jedi librarian/Legends|Jedi Librarian]] [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]], used the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] to find the planet of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], which was missing from the archives, suggesting that it didn't exist. Troubled, Kenobi decided to discuss the issue with Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].<ref name="aotc" />

[[File:FettKenobiMeeting.png|thumb|left|250px|Obi-Wan Kenobi meeting Jango Fett.]]
Yoda was instructing [[Bear Clan]], a group of [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]]. One of them, [[J. K. Burtola/Legends|J. K. Burtola]], suggested that Kamino had been erased from the archives, and Yoda told Kenobi to travel to the coordinates. Kenobi found Kamino where the coordinates said it should be, near the [[Rishi Maze/Legends|Rishi Maze]]. He landed on the rainy, [[Ocean/Legends|oceanic]] planet and was greeted by Kaminoan [[Taun We/Legends|Taun We]], who took Kenobi to the [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]], [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]]. Su told Kenobi about a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]] that they had created for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and to tell the Jedi Master [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] that the order will be shipped on schedule, confusing Kenobi as the Jedi Master had been [[Death/Legends|dead]] for a decade. The two Kaminoans revealed that the host was a bounty hunter named [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Taun We took Kenobi to Fett's living quarters in Kamino's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]]. Fett's genetically unaltered [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] child, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], allowed Taun We and the Jedi to enter. Jango soon approached the group, and We introduced the Jedi. Kenobi subtly interrogated Fett about the plot to assassinate Amidala, but Fett did not reveal any information. Fett, however, told Boba to close a closet door which contained his Mandalorian armor before answering his questions. He also denied knowledge of Sifo-Dyas, stating that he had been recruited by a [[Dooku/Legends|man named Tyranus]]. As We and Kenobi exited Fett's quarters, Fett and his son prepared to leave Kamino immediately. Kenobi contacted Yoda and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and reported his discoveries, including that Sifo-Dyas had somehow managed to order a clone army for the Republic despite being dead. Yoda demanded that Kenobi bring Fett back to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] capital of Coruscant for further investigation.<ref name="aotc" />

Windu also asked another [[Unidentified Rebel Alliance–affiliated individual|Jedi]] to assist Kenobi.<ref name="Cards">''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' Quest portion</ref>

==Duel==
{{Quote|Dad, look!''"<br />"''Boba, get on board!|Boba and Jango Fett upon seeing Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="aotc" />}}
[[File:JangoVSKenobiAOTC.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Obi-Wan and Jango duel near ''Slave I'']]
While loading cargo onto their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], the Fetts prepared to leave Kamino, but Kenobi ran out onto the landing platform where ''Slave I'' was docked. Kenobi's presence alerted young Boba, who shouted to his father that the Jedi found them. Kenobi ignited his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], which forced Jango to pull out his twin [[WESTAR-34 blaster pistol/Legends|WESTAR-34 blaster pistols]] and open fire on the Jedi. As Kenobi deflected Jango's blaster fire, the bounty hunter ignited his [[JT-12 jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] and hid himself on top of a lighting fixture. Unbeknownst to Kenobi, Jango fired the jetpack's [[Missile/Legends|missile]] at the Jedi, which exploded nearby, causing Kenobi to lose his lightsaber. Inside ''Slave I''{{'s}} cockpit, Boba activated the starship's heavy twin [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] and fired towards Kenobi. The shots hit nearby, and Kenobi was thrown backwards across the platform. Jango reemerged from the fixture and flew towards Kenobi, who [[Force jump/Legends|Force Jumped]] and kicked Fett, knocking the bounty hunter to the ground, and causing him to loose both of his blasters.<ref name="aotc" />

[[File:SuperFettMan_AotC.png|thumb|left|250px|Jango, using his Whipcord launcher to grab onto Kenobi.]]
As the two engaged in hand-to-hand combat, Jango tried to grab onto the Jedi. With a quick kick at the bounty hunter's helmet, Jango was forced to release Kenobi. Upon regaining his feet, Fett stood up and [[Keldabe kiss/Legends|head-butted]] Kenobi with his helmet, causing Kenobi to fall back onto the platform. The Jedi noticed his lightsaber near the edge of the platform and tried to [[Telekinesis/Legends|call]] it to him. Jango shot his [[Whipcord launcher/Legends|whipcord launcher]] at the Jedi, and the cord wrapped around the Jedi's outstretched hand and yanked him away from his lightsaber, dragging him across the platform.<ref name="aotc" />

Kenobi tangled the whipcord around a lighting fixture, causing Jango to crash onto the platform. The jetpack was released from his armor and exploded nearby. Standing up, the bounty hunter grabbed onto one of his fallen blasters and fired at Kenobi, who was running towards Jango. Kenobi kicked Jango off the platform, and then realized that he was still connected to the whipcord around his hands. Kenobi was flipped onto the side of the platform and slid down towards Jango.<ref name="aotc" />

[[File:Duel_on_Kamino.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Boba attends the duel between his father and Kenobi.]]
Desperate to save his life, Jango activated a series of grappling tools on his arm and dug them into the platform to slow down his fall. Kenobi, however, slid past Jango and off over the edge of the platform, where he dangled, held by the whipcord. As Jango's grappling tools were failing due to the added weight, Jango released the whipcord, causing Kenobi to freefall down towards the ocean. Using the Force, Kenobi managed to throw the cord and attach it onto a structure below the platform. After making sure that the Jedi was nowhere to be seen, Jango used his grappling tools to crawl back to the top of the platform. Meanwhile, Kenobi flipped onto a ramp and reentered the city to catch up to Jango, who was boarding ''Slave I''. Kenobi reemerged onto the platform and quickly recovered his lightsaber. Both Fetts, however, were aboard ''Slave I'', which was now lifting off, and Kenobi to threw a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] onto the side of the starship's hull.<ref name="aotc" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Dad! I think we're being tracked!''"<br />"''He must have put a homing device on our hull.|Boba and Jango Fett noticing a Jedi starfighter approaching|<ref name="aotc" />}}
After Jango and Boba Fett left Kamino, Kenobi boarded his [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 Jedi Starfighter]] and tracked ''Slave I'' in the [[Geonosis system/Legends|Geonosis system]]. Once more, Kenobi [[Dogfight over Geonosis/Legends|engaged]] Fett over the [[asteroid field]] above the planet. After the conflict, Kenobi learned more of the assassination attempt on Amidala on Geonosis when he intercepted Jango and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Kenobi tried to contact his padawan, Anakin Skywalker, however he was not on Naboo. After he found out that Anakin disobeyed him, he contacted his apprentice on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and told him to redirect his message to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Kenobi told Windu, Yoda and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] about how he tracked Jango Fett to a [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|Droid foundry]] on Geonosis. The newly formed [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]], and [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] is behind the assassination attempt on Amidala. Kenobi was then captured by Dooku's [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] workers and was held captive until the arrival of Skywalker and Amidala, whom attempted to rescue him, though they were captured as well. The [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the first battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], began after the arrival of Windu and his [[Jedi assault team/Legends|Jedi strike team]]. Fett engaged Windu during the battle, and was killed after the Jedi Master used [[Sai cha/Legends|Sai cha]] to decapitate the bounty hunter.<ref name="aotc" />

==Behind the scenes==
Obi-Wan Kenobi's mission to Kamino was created for the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], written and directed by [[George Lucas]].<ref name="aotc" />

===Non-canon content===
{{Quote|I missed you on Kamino by two days.|Darth Maul in a non-canon storyline|<ref name="Old Wounds">{{StoryCite|book=Star Wars: Visionaries|story=Old Wounds}}</ref>}}
In the [[2005]] comic "[[Old Wounds]]," written and illustrated by [[Aaron McBride]], the Sith [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], having survived his [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|encounter]] with Kenobi ten years earlier, followed Kenobi to Kamino after his mission, arriving two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later. Maul recounted his search after finding Kenobi on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[16 BBY/Legends|16 BBY]].<ref name="Old Wounds" />
